name: AICSS
tagline: Copy-paste UI components for AI agent conversations
description: 13 components for the parts of a product that only show up once an agent is talking: thinking and reasoning traces, tool calls, streaming text, inline citations, diff and comparison tables. Plain CSS with no Tailwind dependency, shipped for React, Vue and Svelte.
